description: This is a C++ source file implementing the PackagerImplementation class, which manages package installation, synchronization, and configuration for a plugin system using opkg package manager. It handles installing packages, updating configurations, managing plugin lifecycle, and repository synchronization.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package management tasks such as install, sync, and configuration updates within the plugin system.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the global opkg configuration structure based on current class member variables.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package manager with paths and options extracted from plugin service and configuration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for package events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a specific package by name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: SynchronizeRepository
methods.description: Triggers synchronization of the package repository.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Core method that performs package installation or repository synchronization based on provided parameters.

methods.name: BlockingInstallUntilCompletionNoLock
methods.description: Performs package installation synchronously, updating progress and state.

methods.name: GetMetadataFile
methods.description: Constructs the file path to package metadata JSON file.

methods.name: GetCallsign
methods.description: Reads package metadata file to extract the plugin callsign.

methods.name: GetInstallationPath
methods.description: Returns the full installation path for a given app name.

methods.name: UpdateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates plugin configuration with plugin callsign and installation path.

methods.name: DeactivatePlugin
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin identified by callsign and updates its configuration.

methods.name: NotifyStateChange
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners about a change in package installation state.

methods.name: NotifyRepoSynced
methods.description: Notifies all listeners that repository synchronization has completed.

methods.name: InitOPKG
methods.description: Initializes the opkg package management system with the current configuration.

methods.name: FreeOPKG
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with opkg.

methods.name: BlockingSetupLocalRepoNoLock
methods.description: Sets up local repository, optionally updating package lists based on mode.
